decision: Resolve an ambiguous Cursor runtime with an explicit DEFT_GITHUB_AUTH_MODE=host-gh env selection, and deny managed cloud by a positive CURSOR_AGENT_SOCKET agent/runtime read

governingRule.description: Marker absence and OS predicates must never select host credentials; a credential grant needs a positive assertion or an explicit operator selection

alternativesConsidered.option: process.platform === win32 as a cloud discriminator (originally bound, withdrawn: Cursor runs Windows My Machines workers, and an Ubuntu-only managed fleet is a versioned third-party fact)
Principal validation on the enforcing path (stronger, but couples this fix to #3858)
plan.policy field (committed, so it propagates to other machines and managed VMs -- wrong scope)
CLI flag (reaches scm:status only, not the other SCM-dependent verbs)

whyWinner: The socket metadata read is a positive managed-cloud assertion and outranks the opt-in, so absence stays ambiguous rather than granting; an env var matches the lifetime and blast radius of an execution-environment decision and mirrors the existing github_auth_mode envelope field
revisitTrigger: If Cursor exposes a positive local-worker runtime identity, or once principal validation (#3858) reaches the enforcing path, replace the explicit selection with the stronger check
